source.source_text: Purpose: Docker runtime/container/image/storage summary through brokered adapter, never a raw socket proxy. Input: include_images?:boolean, include_storage?:boolean. Output: daemon state, bounded objects and storage facts. Contract: L2 read_only; scope mac.docker.read; target docker_runtime; timeout 10000ms; cap 512KiB; local Docker only; no generic socket exposure; redact env/mount secrets; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 3 planned.
